scope: Review exact manual positioning in an existing graph: batch validation, undo, unchanged nodes, comments, IDs, help and output. No automatic tidy or graph rewiring.
limitations: Synthetic in-memory workflow, not every node class or maximum batch size.
Exact placement intentionally permits overlaps and backward wires; no automatic tidy or comment-content movement.
No persistence, compilation or runtime behavior certification.

confirmed_bug.description: Boolean x=true was coerced to 1, moved the node and dirtied the package instead of refusing.

repair.description: Require actual JSON number fields and a string ID before conversion. Explain exact placement, comment-only movement and safety prerequisites in live help.

prior_runs.reason: Build passed, but live tool help hid the placement warnings after the first sentence. Moved essential semantics into the summary and parameter help.

controls: Mixed valid and missing-node batch refuses without moving first node
Invalid requests and matching no-op keep clean package
Exact edit and read-back, unlisted comment preserved, undo restores position
Comment-only movement leaves contained node and box dimensions unchanged
Live help exposes manual-placement limits and input format
evidence.visual_review: Native screenshot inspected: node visible within unchanged comment with readable text and expected spacing.
evidence.registration: Same tested wrapper moved from temporary backward-review entry to test-positions-review; backward wrapper restored. No production behavior changed after this engine run.
